verdict.rationale: Brex documents automations such as spend policies, multi-level approval routing, and AI audit and review agents, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of those automations. Auto-approval by agents and the claim of 'total transparency' are adjacent features, not version history or rollback of the automation configuration itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
